sentences.text: vs. State of West Bengal & Anr.
Ms. Puspita Saha ... for the State
The revisional application relates to Baduria Police Station case under Section 498A/406/376/511 of the IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Ms. Puspita Saha, learned counsel for the State present in court is appointed to represent the State in this case.
As none appears for the the petitioners in spite of repeated calls since the date of listing, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected application stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial in accordance with law.
Learned counsel for the State to inform the status of this case to the concerned authority.

( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
